summary: SIEM feed s102_single is degraded: 56.3% of frames (1705/3030) are VXLAN-encapsulated, hiding inner headers from SIEM inspection.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is forwarding VXLAN-encapsulated traffic without stripping the outer header. 56.3% VXLAN encapsulation indicates traffic from a VXLAN overlay is being mirrored as-is to the tool port.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM cannot parse inner L2-L4 headers and flow 5-tuple inside VXLAN; correlation, rule matching and detection coverage for inner hosts/services is blind for >50% of traffic despite SIEM not requiring full payload or bidirectional flows.

recommended_fix.why: Stripping VXLAN at the packet broker exposes inner Ethernet/IP headers so the SIEM can parse and correlate flows without needing VXLAN-aware decoding.
